# 2 Chronicles Chapter 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-there-was to-Jehoshaphat riches and-honor for-abundance and-he-allied-by-marriage with-Ahab.

**2** And-he-went-down at-end-of years to Ahab to-Samaria and-he-slaughtered for-him Ahab sheep and-cattle for-abundance and-for-the-people who were-with-him and-he-incited-him to-go-up to Ramoth-gilead.

**3** And-he-said Ahab king-of Israel to Jehoshaphat king-of Judah will-you-go with-me to-Ramoth-gilead and-he-said to-him as-me as-you and-as-your-people my-people and-with-you in-the-battle.

**4** And-he-said Jehoshaphat to king-of Israel seek please as-today word-of YHWH.

**5** And-he-gathered king-of Israel the-prophets four-hundred men and-he-said to-them shall-we-go to Ramoth-gilead to-battle or shall-I-refrain and-they-said go-up and-God will-give-it in-hand-of the-king.

**6** And-he-said Jehoshaphat is-there-not here still a-prophet of-YHWH and-we-may-seek from-him.

**7** And-he-said king-of Israel to Jehoshaphat still one man to-seek YHWH from-him and-I I-hate-him for not he-prophesies concerning-me good ever but all his-days evil and-he is Micaiah son-of Imla and-he-said Jehoshaphat let-not say the-king so.

**8** And-he-called king-of Israel to an-officer one and-he-said bring-quickly Micaiah son-of Imla.

**9** And-king-of Israel and-Jehoshaphat king-of Judah were-sitting each on his-throne dressed in-robes and-sitting in-the-threshing-floor at-entrance-of gate-of Samaria and-all the-prophets prophesying before-them.

**10** And-he-made for-himself Zedekiah son-of Chenaanah horns-of iron and-he-said thus says YHWH with-these you-shall-gore Aram until-consuming-them.

**11** And-all the-prophets were-prophesying so saying go-up to-Ramoth-gilead and-prosper and-He-will-give YHWH in-hand-of the-king.

**12** And-the-messenger who went to-call Micaiah spoke to-him saying behold words-of the-prophets one mouth good to the-king and-let-be please your-word like-one from-them and-you-shall-speak good.

**13** And-he-said Micaiah as-lives YHWH that what shall-say my-God that I-will-speak.

**14** And-he-came to the-king and-he-said the-king to-him Micaiah shall-we-go to-Ramoth-gilead to-battle or shall-I-refrain and-he-said go-up and-prosper and-they-shall-be-given in-your-hand.

**15** And-he-said to-him the-king how-many times am-I making-you-swear that not you-shall-speak to-me only truth in-name-of YHWH.

**16** And-he-said I-saw all Israel scattered on the-mountains as-the-sheep that have-no shepherd and-He-said YHWH there-is-no masters to-these let-them-return each to-his-house in-peace.

**17** And-he-said king-of Israel to Jehoshaphat did-not I-say to-you not he-prophesies concerning-me good but evil.

**18** And-he-said therefore hear word-of YHWH I-saw YHWH sitting on His-throne and-all host-of the-heavens standing on-His-right and-on-His-left.

**19** And-He-said YHWH who will-entice Ahab king-of Israel and-he-shall-go-up and-he-shall-fall at-Ramoth-gilead and-he-said this one-saying thus and-this one-saying thus.

**20** And-he-came-out the-spirit and-he-stood before YHWH and-he-said I I-will-entice-him and-He-said YHWH to-him by-what.

**21** And-he-said I-will-go-out and-I-will-be a-spirit-of falsehood in-mouth-of all his-prophets and-He-said you-will-entice and-also you-will-prevail go-out and-do so.

**22** And-now behold He-put YHWH a-spirit-of falsehood in-mouth-of these your-prophets and-YHWH spoke concerning-you evil.

**23** And-he-came-near Zedekiah son-of Chenaanah and-he-struck Micaiah on the-cheek and-he-said which-way passed spirit-of YHWH from-me to-speak to-you.

**24** And-he-said Micaiah behold you are-seeing in-the-day that when-you-go room in-a-room to-hide-yourself.

**25** And-he-said king-of Israel take Micaiah and-return-him to Amon ruler-of the-city and-to Joash son-of the-king

**26** and-you-shall-say thus says the-king put this-one in-house-of the-prison and-feed-him bread-of distress and-water-of distress until-I-return in-peace.

**27** And-he-said Micaiah if returning you-return in-peace not has-spoken YHWH by-me and-he-said hear peoples all-of-them.

**28** And-he-went-up king-of Israel and-Jehoshaphat king-of Judah to Ramoth-gilead.

**29** And-he-said king-of Israel to Jehoshaphat I-will-disguise-myself and-go into-the-battle and-you put-on your-robes and-he-disguised-himself king-of Israel and-they-went into-the-battle.

**30** And-king-of Aram commanded the-commanders-of the-chariots that were-for-him saying not you-shall-fight with-the-small or with-the-great except with king-of Israel alone.

**31** And-it-was as-saw commanders-of the-chariot Jehoshaphat and-they said king-of Israel is-he and-they-surrounded against-him to-fight and-he-cried-out Jehoshaphat and-YHWH helped-him and-He-turned-them God from-upon-him.

**32** And-it-was as-saw commanders-of the-chariot that not was king-of Israel and-they-returned from-after-him.

**33** And-a-man drew the-bow in-his-innocence and-he-struck king-of Israel between the-joints and-between the-armor and-he-said to-the-charioteer turn your-hand and-take-me-out from the-camp for I-am-wounded.

**34** And-the-battle went-up in-the-day that and-king-of Israel was propped-up in-the-chariot opposite Aram until the-evening and-he-died at-time-of setting-of the-sun.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **18:1**: he-allied-by-marriage with-Ahab — The verb chatan (to become son-in-law/ally by marriage) signals the dangerous political entanglement that will define Jehoshaphat's failures.

- **18:13**: what shall-say my-God that I-will-speak — Micaiah's oath of prophetic integrity: he will speak only God's word, regardless of political consequences.

- **18:21**: a-spirit-of falsehood — The divine council scene reveals that even deceptive spirits operate under YHWH's sovereignty. God permits deception as judgment.

- **18:33**: in-his-innocence — Hebrew le-tummo, meaning without specific aim. The 'random' arrow is divinely guided — the greatest irony in the narrative.


— EMET
